gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: The disclosed 'GBP 9.5m released' figure is stated as a release of technical reserves (not explicitly 'gross claims outstanding' only). The requirement asks for a GROSS claims outstanding prioryear movement; the note gives a technical reserves release encompassing more than claims outstanding. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (claims-only) figure is separately reported. Hence the prior year development value is taken from the narrative 'Movement in prior year's provision' statement and interpreted as a gross release of technical reserves. Confidence is reduced accordingly. No gross claims development triangle is provided in the accounts.
